Mixed filename + URL: only the URL becomes an autolink (#397)

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"foobar.png\">foobar.png</a> <a href=\"https://www.heise.de\">https://www.heise.de</a>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
